articles.title: DOJ says Hamas crypto seizures reached $560,000 as FBI took over fundraising sites
articles.snippet: FBI agents took control of domains and servers, specifically Alqassam.ps, to intercept donations and prevent further fundraising for the Al-Qassam Brigades.

articles.title: FBI Seizes $560K in Crypto Bound for Hamas, Takes Over Fundraising Sites
articles.snippet: Agents seized digital assets, domains, and servers allegedly used by Hamas’ military wing to collect donations and recruit supporters.

articles.title: Tether Sued Over Alleged Unlawful Freeze of $42.4 Million in USDT
articles.snippet: Two Thai businessmen claim Tether blocked access to their stablecoins months before federal authorities secured a seizure warrant.
